combo.description: To burst someone down quickly Q and instantly Flash. AA E as quickly as you can.
When you want to get on top of an enemy to burst them R and right before the damage hits the ground F and instantly Q E eAA.
To execute someone quickly Flash then instantly Q E eAA.
To all in Q and instantly AA E followed by an AA. W right before using R, then AA as quickly as you can.
If you want to trade back damage as you retreat AA then instantly E Q and use W to escape.
When quickly trading Q and instantly E eAA.
When trading Q then instantly AA twice, quickly using E as the second AA finishes.
